- Billing changes requested: invoice to be sent to "Consortium AI — Accounts Payable" (ap@consortium.ai) starting with the April invoice.
- PO: please share the Purchase Order (PO) referencing RDW-2026-1187; we need the payor entity name and PO number for our finance system.
- Net terms request: you mentioned Net60 during the call; that requires approval from our finance team — copying Neha to confirm next steps.

If you can send the PO and your W-9, we’ll route the invoice and confirm if Net60 is approved. Proposed next steps for our side:
1) Once we receive PO + W-9, Neha will confirm billing entity acceptance and any documentation gaps.
2) Connor will provision the capacity add-on on a canary pool so the new quota appears by 2026-04-01.
3) Marissa will follow up on usage reporting and enable per-route cost breakdowns for your finance team.

Appreciate the quick handoff — let me know if AP should send the PO to finance@redwood.com or directly to me.

Thanks,

Thanks Vivek / Alex — I reviewed the PO and W-9. Quick finance checklist and suggested next steps:

- PO CN-2026-4491 references the correct legal entity (Consortium AI Inc.) and includes the amount for the committed capacity. Good.
- W-9 present and matches entity name.
- Net60 request: requires credit approval (standard for new net terms). We can provision temporary Net30 while we complete the credit check, or accept Net60 with the following guardrails: 1) initial invoice on Net30 for 30 days while we run credit; 2) if credit check clears within 30 days we can reissue subsequent invoices as Net60; 3) require a signed amendment for Net60 terms (finance will prepare).

Action items for Redwood:
- Finance (me): initiate credit check and prepare a short one-paragraph amendment for Net60 (I’ll draft and share via DocuSign).
- Billing ops (Connor): confirm whether invoices can be routed to ap@consortium.ai immediately or require the AP team to be added to our billing contacts list (if you expect centralized invoice processing).
- Accounts (Vivek): confirm whether Consortium needs the invoice billed to a different legal entity for tax reasons — sometimes customers request invoice to a subsidiary and give a separate PO; if so we need the crosswalk documentation.

I’ll start the credit verification today and aim to have a draft amendment by EOD tomorrow.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
